title: Robot and Spartan Chalkboard
description: A steampunk robot with multiple mechanical arms holds glowing orbs depicting galaxies and nebulae, standing beside a large ornate chalkboard. The chalkboard displays white chalk drawings of ancient Greek warriors and Spartans in armor holding shields and spears, set against a mystical dark background with floating geometric symbols and jellyfish-like forms.
prompt: A detailed surreal fantasy scene featuring a steampunk robot with multiple extending mechanical arms, each holding glowing orbs that contain miniature galaxies, nebulae and cosmic scenes, standing on a circular platform with candles next to a large ornate framed chalkboard. On the chalkboard are intricate white chalk drawings of ancient Greek Spartan warriors in helmets and armor holding large round shields and spears, one kneeling with a sword. The background is a dark mystical purple space filled with floating geometric symbols, stars, and ethereal jellyfish-like creatures, in a painterly digital art style with glowing accents.
